newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Profit-taking trims Fotex, recovery seen.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking trims Fotex, recovery seen.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian retailer Fotex, suspended on Friday due to too rapid rally, have given up some nine percent in early trading on Monday but traders expected a recovery by the end of play.

"Those investors are unloading Fotex shares who have been sitting on their holdings for a long while," one trader said. "But there is fairly stable demand at 200 forints...so I expect it to close higher."
At 1020 GMT Fotex stood at 205 forints. It opened at 220 forints, and fell to a day low of 196 forints as sales by one major brokerage was followed by others.
Trading in Fotex was suspended on Friday after a more than 26 percent rise to 220 forints.
